standaloneForms.name: Onboarding Form🎉
standaloneForms.description:
_Beyond grateful to have you here. Let's Get Started!_

This form is one of the most important parts of the entire engagement.

The quality of your answers directly impacts:
- Lead list quality
- Cold email performance
- Reply handling
- Appointment quality
- Campaign success

Please answer every question thoroughly.

Short, generic answers like:
- “We help businesses grow”
- “We’re different because we care more”
- “We generate leads”
- “We’ve been doing this for 20 years”

are not helpful...

standaloneForms.name: Inbox Manager Daily Report📨
standaloneForms.description:
This form is your daily check-in to track reply handling, meeting bookings, and follow-ups. It helps ensure nothing slips through the cracks, and we stay proactive in converting interest into meetings for our clients.

By filling this out each shift, you’re helping us:

✅ Stay aligned on lead quality, volume, and interest
✅ Spot issues early (e.g. bad leads, confusing scripts, delayed follow-ups)
✅ Keep communication seamless between the inbox and campaign teams

standaloneForms.name: Executive Assistant Daily Report📆
standaloneForms.description:
This form is your daily check-in to help keep operations smooth, priorities clear, and the Founder’s time protected. It’s designed to help us:

✅ Track progress across business and personal tasks
✅ Flag blockers or high-priority items that need attention
✅ Identify where time is being saved—or lost
✅ Maintain order in systems, calendars, and communication

Please be clear and specific—this helps the Founder stay in control and see the bigger picture.

standaloneForms.name: Closer/SDR Daily Report💸
